title: Nausea-Friendly Pregnancy Meals: Nutritious Options for a Healthy Pregnancy
excerpt: Smaller meals, gentler textures, and nutrient-dense snacks to help manage morning sickness
content:
## Introduction to Morning Sickness and Prenatal Nutrition
Morning sickness is one of the most common symptoms of pregnancy, affecting around 80% of expectant mothers. During this time, eating can become challenging due to nausea and vomiting. However, nutrition remains crucial for the development of the fetus and the mother's health.

## Choosing the Right Foods
When experiencing morning sickness, it's essential to opt for foods that are easy to digest, low in fat, and lightly seasoned. Some suggestions include:
- Easy-to-digest fruits and vegetables like apples, bananas, and carrots
- Lean proteins like chicken, fish, and eggs
- White rice, white bread, and pasta
- Gentle soups and stews

## Snacking and Nutritional Supplements
Snacking is a vital part of a pregnant woman's diet, especially when experiencing morning sickness. Some snack ideas include:
- Yogurt and fruit
- Crackers and milk
- Dried fruit and nuts

## Food Safety During Pregnancy
Food safety is a critical concern during pregnancy. Expectant mothers should avoid foods that can cause food poisoning, such as:
- Raw or undercooked foods
- Expired or spoiled foods
- Improperly stored foods

For more information on food safety and prenatal nutrition, expectant mothers can visit [our website](/blog/topics) or [learn about our pregnancy meal planner](/planner).

## Conclusion
Morning sickness can be a challenging time during pregnancy, but with the right food choices and nutrient-dense snacks, expectant mothers can ensure a healthy pregnancy. Remember to always prioritize food safety and consult with a healthcare provider or registered dietitian if you have any concerns.

## When to Seek Help
If you experience any of the following symptoms, seek help from a healthcare provider or registered dietitian:
- Severe nausea and vomiting
- Weight loss or failure to gain weight
- Abdominal pain or diarrhea
